high_level_description: This image appears to be a social media post from Nike, as indicated by the Nike logo in the top left corner. The post was made 22 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The image features two individuals standing in front of a green corrugated metal wall. Both individuals are wearing red jackets with black and white patterns that resemble a soccer ball design. The jacket on the left has "KENYA" written on it, along with a small flag emblem, suggesting a connection to Kenya or Kenyan sports.
